name: 👁️ Into The Abyss
desc:
[ ⚠️ This Game is in Late Alpha, it will receive updates often. Expect Bugs! ]

[ 👥 This Game is Suitable for 1-4 Players, and uses Proximity Text and Voice Chat ]

[ 🎮 Controls ]
E - Interact, Pick Up
Q - Drop Item
C - Crouch, Slide while running
Shift - Run, Door Bash
Space - Dodge Roll

[ 📜 Story ]
Once a Government Funded Operation working on Harnessing Unlimited Power from Elusive Relics, A.R.C is Now Tasked with Cleaning Up their own Mistakes. Artifacts have been responsible for holding the rest of the facility up in shambles, as well as resurrecting lethal threats bent on stopping you.

The Target? The CORE Artifact. 
The Abyss Divers? You. 
The Transport? A Service Elevator.

A.R.C is legally required to inform all Abyss Diver Candidates:

Ｅｖｅｎ   Ｉｎ   Ｔｈｅ   Ａｂｙｓｓ， Ｙｏｕ   ａｒｅ   Ｎｏｔ   Ａｌｏｎｅ 👁️

Inspired by The Upturned, Lethal Company, Pressure, DESCENT, and Minus/Depth Spelunking
